title: Kill Bots Lip Sync
eyebrow: GPOM scene A · lip-sync pass, 18 Nov
heading: The toilet row: pick the best lip sync per line
intro: Each line: what's in the film now, then the three best new pairs (a new talking clip with a new voice take, same words, fitted whole to the mouth, never early, never chopped). New clips play their full 5-6 s with the room bed; the film version is trimmed to the line. Pick one per row ('Now in the film' keeps it) and leave a note. Derek's first line didn't fit well on any new pair: say if you want it re-shot as two shorter clips.

sections.lede: Sandra and Derek in the bunker toilet, five lines in film order.
